test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The population of a village was 1,00,000. It increased by 5% in the first year and increased by 20% in the second year. Its population after two years is _______.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Successive percentage change** formula: Net % change = a + b + (a × b)/100

Net % increase = 5 + 20 + (5 × 20)/100 = 5 + 20 + 1 = 26%

Final Population = 1,00,000 × (126/100) = 1,26,000

**∴ The correct answer is 1,26,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Initial population** = 1,00,000, **First year increase** = 5%, **Second year increase** = 20%

**Formula:** Final Population = P × (1 + r₁/100) × (1 + r₂/100)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e36def9286c5f5d06de488256b182f93e536d5cb5a32acf4ddd5007981f9c51c.png] 

⇒ Population after 1st year = 1,00,000 × (105/100) = 1,05,000

⇒ Population after 2nd year = 1,05,000 × (120/100)

⇒ Population after 2nd year = 1,05,000 × 1.2 = 1,26,000

**∴ The correct answer is 1,26,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When a value changes by a% and then by b%, the net change is given by (a + b + ab/100)%.

Population Growth Formula

If the growth rate is constant (r), the population after n years is P(1 + r/100)ⁿ, similar to compound interest.

Percentage Increase vs Decrease

For increase, use +r; for decrease (depreciation), use −r in the multiplicative factor (1 ± r/100).</p
